The team is led by fifth-year head coach [[Jamie Dixon]], and plays their home games at [[Schollmaier Arena]] in [[Fort Worth, Texas]] as a member of the [[Big 12 Conference]]. They finished the season 12-14, 5-11 in [[2020–21 Big 12 Conference men's basketball season|Big 12 Play]] to finish in 8th place. They lost in the first round of the [[2021 Big 12 men's basketball tournament|Big 12 tournament]] to [[2020–21 Kansas State Wildcats men's basketball team|Kansas State]].{{cite news|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/401301702|title=K-State cruises to 71-50 win over TCU in Big 12 tourney|work=[[ESPN]]|date=March 10, 2021|access-date=June 30, 2025}} ==Previous season== They finished the season 16–15, 7–11 in [[2019–20 Big 12 Conference men's basketball season|Big 12 play]] to finish in a tie for seventh place.
